en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate house or villa, partly hidden among dense forest. The house has a prominent tower with a steep, pointed roof. The text 'Tomtebo, Ånge.' appears in the upper left corner. The reverse side shows a classic divided-back postcard layout with space for a message and address, along with a stamp box and Swedish printing mark.
